Since mutual information is bounded below by zero, this monotone sequence converges: the original signal degrades monotonically across generations.
Moreover, when the generation operator defines a finite-state Markov chain, the marginal distributions of adjacent generations converge to a shared stationary distribution, so that any classifier's ability to distinguish depth $k$ from depth $k{+}1$ must eventually degrade to chance.
